first_useful_action.note: Found plans/** excluded from markdownlint — empty file list exits 0.

answer: No — exit 0 is not a pass when the only named inputs sit under plans/**. .markdownlintignore deliberately excludes plans/** ("internal planning content with its own conventions"), so `markdownlint --ignore-path .markdownlintignore` on a plans/ APS module receives an empty file list, prints its usage banner, and still exits 0 without examining anything. That non-verdict-as-pass defect is recorded as CIB-390 in plans/modules/continuous-improvement-backlog.aps.md (shape A); do not remove plans/** from the ignore file — APS has its own lint. .github/workflows/README.md "Reading PR readiness (CIB-390)" covers the sibling shape B (mid-flight CI read as a settled pass). Keep treating anvil_validate_write as the write gate; this V1 session used no GCTX tools and no Decision Brief.
